name: Lustful Wife Aiko
source:
"Lustful Wife Aiko" is an adult Visual Novel about Cuckolding. As Hitoshi begins to suspect his wife Aiko's infidelity with her boss, those doubts build into forbidden desires. Will adopting the cuckold lifestyle destroy him?

Hitoshi's boring life suddenly changes when he hears a rumor about his beloved wife Aiko's infidelity with her boss, Ryou, the future heir to the company and his old-time friend. Refusing to believe it at first, he finds himself going down a rabbit hole of doubt, fear and distrust as Aiko gets closer to Ryou. As he imagines his wife being taken by another man, a dark desire grows inside him. Will his marriage be able to withstand the presence of another man?

[From [url=https://raspberrysoft.itch.io/lustful-wife-aiko]Patreon[/url]]
